title: Tauroursodeoxycholic Acid Inhibits NF-kappaB/p300/H3K14ac to Attenuate Microglial Activation in Lipopolysaccharide-treated BV-2 Cells and Mice.
authors: Qi, Dexin; Yi, Runxi; Yang, Jipeng; Qiu, Xiaoyue; Huang, Jingying; Liu, Zeyao; Liu, Yaya; Qi, Jinsheng; Li, Yanning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TUDCA通过抑制NF-kappaB/p300/H3K14ac表观遗传通路减轻小胶质细胞活化，涉及NF-kappaB与iNOS启动子结合及分子对接，但核心是神经炎症药理机制，非TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: Tauroursodeoxycholic acid (TUDCA) shows therapeutic potential for neuroinflammation and related neuropsychiatric disorders. However, the intrinsic mechanism by which TUDCA counteracts microglial activation and neuroinflammation has not been clarified. In this study, the epigenetic mechanism through which TUDCA regulates inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) generation to antagonize microglial activation was investigated in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-treated microglial BV-2 cells and mice. The results confirmed the inhibitory effects of TUDCA on LPS-induced iNOS overgeneration, oxidative stress and microglial activation in BV-2 cells. Mechanistically, TUDCA inhibited the recruitment of NF-kappaB and the histone acetyltransferase p300 to the iNOS gene promoter and reduced the enrichment of histone H3 lysine 14 acetylation (H3K14ac), but not H3K9ac in LPS-stimulated BV-2 cells. Moreover, TUDCA inhibited the binding and co-localization of NF-kappaB and p300, and reduced the p300-bound H3K14ac in LPS-stimulated BV-2 cells. Although the bile acid nuclear receptor farnesoid X receptor (FXR) has been reported to inhibit the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, its content hardly changed among the groups, indicating TUDCA's effects independent of FXR in this context. In addition, molecular docking predicted specific binding between TUDCA and p300. Consistent with the cellular findings, TUDCA alleviated neuroinflammation and behavioral abnormalities in LPS-treated mice. TUDCA also attenuated microglial activation in the hippocampus and reduced brain H3K14ac level. In conclusion, TUDCA inhibited NF-kappaB/p300 activity and decreased H3K14ac enrichment at the iNOS gene promoter, thereby attenuating microglial activation in both LPS-treated BV-2 cells and mice.
abstract_zh: 牛磺熊去氧胆酸（TUDCA）在神经炎症及相关神经精神疾病中显示出治疗潜力。然而，TUDCA对抗小胶质细胞激活和神经炎症的内在机制尚未阐明。本研究在脂多糖（LPS）处理的小胶质细胞BV-2细胞和小鼠中，探讨了TUDCA通过表观遗传机制调节诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）生成以拮抗小胶质细胞激活的作用。结果证实了TUDCA对LPS诱导的BV-2细胞中iNOS过度生成、氧化应激和小胶质细胞激活的抑制作用。机制上，TUDCA抑制了NF-kappaB和组蛋白乙酰转移酶p300向iNOS基因启动子的募集，并降低了LPS刺激的BV-2细胞中组蛋白H3赖氨酸14乙酰化（H3K14ac）的富集，但未影响H3K9ac。此外，TUDCA抑制了NF-kappaB和p300的结合及共定位，并降低了LPS刺激的BV-2细胞中p300结合的H3K14ac。尽管胆汁酸核受体法尼醇X受体（FXR）已被报道可抑制NF-kappaB信号通路，但其含量在各组间几乎没有变化，表明在此背景下TUDCA的作用不依赖于FXR。此外，分子对接预测了TUDCA与p300之间的特异性结合。与细胞实验结果一致，TUDCA缓解了LPS处理小鼠的神经炎症和行为异常。TUDCA还减弱了海马区的小胶质细胞激活，并降低了脑内H3K14ac水平。总之，TUDCA抑制了NF-kappaB/p300活性并降低了iNOS基因启动子处的H3K14ac富集，从而在LPS处理的BV-2细胞和小鼠中减弱了小胶质细胞激活。
